name: 2.9.11 - New customer accounts
notes: New customer accounts: on online orders (pickups and deliveries) and eBay orders, when the phone lookup ends with COSTAR's Customer Not found, Account# is blank and the order has every detail COSTAR's new-customer form asks for (name, street, suburb, state, postcode, phone), the helper makes the customer's COSTAR account: the magnifier beside Account#, Add new, every required box of the form checked against the order, OK once per order, the account confirmed, the customer panel checked again (COSTAR's account number and name kept), then Ship to. A detail missing: no account, the order goes on as before. An unsure result after OK stops the order and is never tried again for it. Switch: Files & settings. Update the RDP helper (and the desk PC, to keep them the same).
